messages:
Amina Rahman: hi folks, i'm Amina in eng-platform 1st day today. i'm following the kube onboarding guide but `kubectl get pods` fails with 'The connection to the server localhost:8080 was refused'. i put the downloaded kubeconfig into ~/.kube/config. any suggestions?
Leo Tan: hey @Amina welcome! two quick checks: 1) run `kubectl config current-context` and 2) open the kubeconfig and see the server url under clusters. sometimes the downloaded file has no server set if the portal step failed.
Amina Rahman: current-context shows 'minikube' which is odd. in ~/.kube/config i see cluster.server: https://api.redwood.internal:6443. maybe the minikube context from my laptop is higher priority?
Leo Tan: yeah if you have a local minikube kubeconfig it can be first in the merged file. try `kubectl config use-context redwood-onboard` or set KUBECONFIG explicitly: `KUBECONFIG=~/redwood.kubeconfig kubectl get ns`.
Amina Rahman: using `KUBECONFIG=~/redwood.kubeconfig kubectl get ns` gives 'Unauthorized' now. guessing RBAC issue.
Leo Tan: correct. new hires get a personal namespace via an onboarding RoleBinding. pinging infra-netops to create ns `onboard-amina` and bind `edit` role to `amina.rahman@redwood.ai`.
infra-netops: Thanks @Leo. Creating namespace onboard-amina and RoleBinding now. Note: if you see 403 but token shows, check that the user field in kubeconfig matches the IdP username exactly.
iam-bot: Ticket IAM-783: create RoleBinding onboard-amina for amina.rahman@redwood.ai created and assigned to infra-netops. ETA ~30m.
Amina Rahman: quick question: i also need to port-forward postgres to test migrations. do we allow port-forwarding from personal namespaces?
Leo Tan: we do for personal namespaces. port-forwarding to cluster-internal services should work, but remember the cluster is private so you need to be on corp VPN or use the bastion. If you can't reach ssh bastion, `kubectl proxy` is sometimes a faster workaround for HTTP endpoints.
Amina Rahman: infra-netops updated RoleBinding and namespace created. `kubectl auth can-i create pods -n onboard-amina` -> yes. Trying port-forward: `kubectl port-forward svc/postgres 5432:5432 -n onboard-amina` shows Forwarding but my app can't connect; connection times out.
infra-netops: We're doing maintenance on the NAT/GW right now; bastion IP was rotated earlier. If you're on VPN that should be fine, but if your workstation routes traffic differently you might need to add a host route. Can you try `traceroute api.redwood.internal`?
Amina Rahman: traceroute times out after the corp VPN hop. I'm on macOS, using the company WireGuard profile.
Leo Tan: For a quick dev loop, you can port-forward to 127.0.0.1 and then set PGHOST=127.0.0.1 PGPORT=5432. If that doesn't work, try `kubectl proxy --port=8001` and hit the proxy path for the service (good for HTTP). For TCP protocols like Postgres, the usual route is port-forward or an SSH tunnel via the bastion.
Amina Rahman: tried port-forward again after infra message and it now works! postgres accepts connections. thanks everyone. if bastion access is flaky later, who should i ping?
infra-netops: ping infra-netops channel or open an incident if it affects more than one person. We'll post status updates.
Amina Rahman: awesome. also super grateful for the fast onboarding patch. :)
Leo Tan: welcome aboard @Amina :rocket: If you want, i'll share a short checklist of kubectl tips in this channel later.
